sources: Killingsworth, Kahneman & Mellers (2023). Income and emotional well-being: A conflict resolved. PNAS 120(10). Adversarial collaboration; experience sampling (Track Your Happiness); happiness rises with income on average; least happy group rises until ~$100k then plateaus; earlier plateau at $75k (Kahneman & Deaton 2010) reflected the unhappy.
